name: Reliance-Digital-clone
description: Reliance Digital clone is an e-commerce web application that allows you to shop different categories of electronics products. It is India's Largest Electronics Retailer & offers a flexible shopping experience. It has a variety of categories, just visit the product listing page and you will see all the products.

paragraphs: Digital Xpress is ECommerce Website & is a clone of Reliance Digital. It is used for buying the electrical products, Home Appliances & other kind of products. Digital Express Digital Stores are bigger in size than the other format Digital Xpress Mini Stores. It is one of the largest electronics retailers in India with over 5,000 products in its inventory.
